# Silk Road Flame

Belly dance and hula performances, plus handcrafted belly dance, mermaid, and custom event costumes by Susana.

## What the site offers

- Book a performance: /book — belly dance, hula, and fusion styles for weddings, festivals, corporate and private events
- Shop ready-made costumes: /shop — one-of-a-kind handcrafted belly dance and mermaid costumes
- Request a custom costume: /custom-orders — bespoke pieces for any event
- Contact: /contact — questions, bookings, and orders
- Payments accepted: PayPal, Venmo, Zelle
- Social: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram (@silkroadflame)
